democracy.t: Voted Nay on the objection to Ohio's 2004 electoral votes (House Roll Call 7; the objection failed 31–267).
Signed the December 2020 House Republican amicus brief supporting Texas v. Pennsylvania (one of 126); the Supreme Court declined the case.
Voted Yea on the objection to Arizona's electoral votes (failed 121–303).
Voted Yea on the objection to Pennsylvania's electoral votes (failed 138–282).
During the Jan. 6 attack tweeted a prayer for God to 'guide & protect this nation'; later said some attackers 'crossed the line.'
